title: One of the best day trips out of Barcelona
text: I went with a couple of friends and it was some of the most fun that we’ve had on our trip to Spain. The locations were breathtaking and the tour guide was not only friendly and informative, but also created a very fun atmosphere. I left with a new appreciation and knowledge on two beautiful cities and with memories that will last me a lifetime time. Our tour guide even treated us to a history lesson on other parts of barcelona, including some famous land marks, giving some recommendations of activities to do and places to see based on our preferences. title: Great Day out..
text: Great day trip with Tarragona and Stiges with Rod at Explore Catalunya, worth every penny.   Definitely one if you like history mixed with a bit of beach time.  Rod was so knowledgeable about the sites we visited.  Highly recommend.
author: Bernadette_A

title: Fabulous Exerience  With Wonderful Guide and Intern!  ❤️
text: We are three elderly ladies with who still have a zest for life.  We went on a private tour with Explore Cataluña to Tarragona and Sitges and we loved it!  Our guide and driver was Rod and he could not have been better.  He was very knowledgeable!  Explained the history and cultures very well.  With us also came Carme an intern and both of them were very thoughtful, professional, courteous and patient!  All of our questions were answered in the most efficient way.  They made this tour be fabulous!!!  All three of us enjoyed our day very much!!!

title: Roman Ruins
text:
Small group tour. We were lucky that it was just our party. We visited the Tarragona aqueduct outside the town and various Roman sites within the town, which were fascinating. Guide Sergei was friendly and informative. 
Much easier on the tour and more informative than taking public transport, particularly to the aqueduct, which was impressive.
author: Odyssey25322112629

title: Fantastic experience
text: Sergio was our guide and he is knowledgeable and genial. The tour started promptly, stuck to the promised itinerary and was very good.
author: Smitha_R

title: Luiz in Tarragona
text: Being in Catalonia is worth a stop in Tarragona. City with a beautiful coastline on the shores of the Mediterranean, features Roman ruins in good state of conservation - highlight for the amphitheatre. Good offer of restaurants.
